page.layout: One centred sticker label on an otherwise blank page: 3 printed lines of text above an emblem, 2 lines below it. No running text. A red library stamp lies below the label, not transcribed.
page.notes: The label carries a stylised emblem (concentric curved lines around a small "VW" monogram), which is not text. The red stamp below the label reads "Xerokopieren aus konservatorischen Gründen nicht erlaubt / Nur im Lesesaal benützbar" (no photocopying for conservation reasons; reading room use only). It is a library stamp and is left out. The pencil letter "F" at the lower left is handwriting and is left out.
